description: Corrections to per-question totals printed in a mark scheme, for misprints and missing totals. "printed" is what check_marks.py reads from the PDF (a number, or null when no total is printed); the correction only applies while the PDF still reads that way. Each records the page and the reason, and is listed on the paper's review sheet. "omitted_rows" lists rows printed in a mark scheme but left out of the bank (e.g. a duplicated row), with the page and the reason; they don't change any total and are listed on the review sheet too.

14.reason: No question total is printed; the parts are (a) 2, (b) 4, (c) 2, (d) 3, (e) 2 = 13, matching the question paper's 'Total for Question 14 is 13 marks'.
